name: Providence Saint Joseph Medical Center Volunteer (16 and up)
what_you_do: Help one shift a week in a spot like the gift shop, front desk or a hospital unit. The hospital says the hours can count for high school.
who_can_apply: You must be at least 16. This is the hospital's general program, not a separate teen program.
duration: At least 100 hours or six months, with one 4-hour shift a week
deadline_text: No deadline is listed as of Nov 3, 2026.
how_to_apply: Read the requirements and apply online. Then you have an interview to match your interests and schedule, and you go to orientation. Questions: 818-847-3501.
notes: You need a TB test each year and a flu shot or a mask during flu season. You must wear the hospital uniform and ID badge.
